Terms of Service

Last updated: 6 November 2026

1. Services

Career documentation and personal branding as described in each package. We don’t provide job placement, visa or immigration services, and we don’t guarantee interviews or job offers.

2. Orders

Submitting an order request isn’t a purchase. Your order is confirmed when we confirm the details and receive payment.

3. Delivery

First drafts are delivered within the stated time (2 days, or 3 days for Executive) after we receive your complete information. Same-day delivery is an optional paid add-on.

4. Revisions

Each package includes the stated number of revisions (3, or 4 for Executive) within [CONFIRM revision window, e.g. 30 days] of the first draft. Revisions refine the agreed scope. New roles or new documents are a new order.

5. Payments and refunds

[CONFIRM refund policy]

6. Your responsibilities

You confirm that the information you give us is accurate and truthful. We won’t write false qualifications or experience.

7. Ownership

After full payment, you may use your final documents freely for your job search. We may reuse anonymized formats and layouts.

8. Liability

Our total liability is limited to the amount you paid for the order.
